LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_EnableVehicleFrame: Enable Vehicle Mod Caravan Speed Support
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_CaravanSpeedMultip: Scales the caravan speed bonus on a logarithmic scale from 0.2x (20%) to 1000x (100000%). Right = faster, left = slower, 1x = unchanged. Has no effect if there is no base speed bonus.
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_MinTicksPerMove_To: Caps maximum caravan speed (1 tick/tile = 60000 tiles/day, the vanilla engine limit). Pathfinding is protected by this mod, so even 1 tick/tile will not cause spiral walking or routing failures.
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_AllowUncappedSpeed: Allows caravans to advance multiple tiles per tick when speed exceeds 60,000 tiles/day. Disabled by default; enable only for extreme modded speed setups.
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_MaxTilesPerTick: Max Tiles Per Tick: {0} (up to {1} tiles/day)
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_MaxTilesPerTick_To: Safety cap on how many tiles a caravan can advance in a single tick when uncapped speed is enabled, preventing freezes at extreme speeds.
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_CaravanSpeedNotCha: No effect because speed bonus not exists
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_MinTicksClamped: Speed clamped to cap: {1} tiles/day (calculated: ~{0} tiles/day; enable Uncap Speed in settings to exceed)
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_MaxTilesClamped: Speed clamped to cap: {1} tiles/day (calculated: {0} tiles/day)
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_CaravanSpeedIncrea: Actual caravan speed increased by: {0}% (~{1} tiles/day)
